$comment: Upskillers: participants in a Build Cycle. Facts from Brendan's journey interview (Sep 29, 2026; the project's user-journey notes): account → workshop → apply (places are limited) → Pods of nine or more form in month one → teams of three to five → the Showcase. Effort is described by its shape (heavy, steady, heavy) until hours are measured. Buttons are new this cycle. The application, its deadline and its questions live inside the account, not on this page.
description: Learn by building a real project with a small team, free, in person, near you.

title: Learn by building.
hero.alt: The Upskiller button: the orb mark on ink, ringed by THE UPSKILLING LABS and UPSKILLER

intro.lede: The Upskilling Labs is a free community where people learn by building real projects together. As an Upskiller, you join a Pod for a Build Cycle, find a problem worth solving, and build something with a small team, beside people who've been where you are.
intro.terms: Twelve weeks, in person: heaviest in month one and before the Showcase, steady in between.
intro.status: Fall 2026 starts Oct 13. Apply from your account.

items.title: Find your Pod.
items.body: In month one, Pods of nine or more form around a problem situation. Everyone lands in one.

items.title: Build it.
items.body: As you reframe the problem and propose projects, teams of three to five form. Your team builds one thing.

items.title: Show it at the Showcase.
items.body: Show your work in public, and keep it going as open source.

items.title: Free, always.
items.body: Workshops and Build Cycles cost nothing.

items.title: In person, near you.
items.body: Evenings at your local public library, with some sessions online.

items.title: No lectures.
items.body: You learn by building, beside beginners and experts.

items.title: Heavy, steady, heavy.
items.body: Month one and the run-up to the Showcase are the busiest; the middle is steady.

path.title: Start small. Finish with something real.

steps.title: Create your account.
steps.body: Your free Upskilling account: sign in with Google. You get Slack and events, and you can apply.

steps.title: Come to a workshop.
steps.body: Free and hands-on. Most people start here.

steps.title: Apply for a Build Cycle.
steps.body: Places are limited. New this cycle: your Upskiller button when you start.

steps.title: Find your Pod, then your team.
steps.body: Pods of nine or more form around a problem; teams of three to five form around the projects you propose. Mentors help when you're stuck.

steps.title: The Showcase.
steps.body: Show what you built, in public.

button.title: Proof you're building.
button.body: New this cycle: given to you when you start a Build Cycle. Wear it to your Pod, and to the Showcase.

items.a: No. Workshops and Build Cycles are free.

items.q: How much time does a Build Cycle take?
items.a: Twelve weeks. It's heaviest in month one, while Pods form, and again before the Showcase, and steady in between.
Not the way you might expect. There are no lectures or grades: workshops teach skills, your Pod is where you practise, Mentors help when you're stuck, and you teach what you learn.

items.q: Will it get me a job?
items.a: It's not job placement. You leave with credited open-source work, an audience at the Showcase, and people who've built with you.

items.q: What if I don't find a team?
items.a: Everyone lands in a Pod. Month one feels uncertain for most people; that's how Pods and teams form.

items.q: Do I need to be technical?
items.a: No. Beginners and experts work side by side, and you learn by doing.
Create your free account, then drop into a workshop. When applications are open, you apply from your account.

join.title: Come build with us.
join.lede: Start with your free account and a workshop. Then apply for the next Build Cycle.
